summary: Invech Holdings (filer) filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of the website and total code of sports betting platform www.sportypick.com from Arpita Day. Consideration was 5,000,000 restricted shares of Invech common stock (no per-share price stated). The transaction closed on April 21, 2026, the same date Invech formed a wholly owned subsidiary, Sporty Pick, Inc. The APA is filed as Exhibit 10.1. Shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506 exemption. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee mentioned. This is a small asset-for-stock deal—watch for subsequent disclosures on post-closing operations or potential dilution. Risk-arb angle minimal due to non-cash nature.
